description: This file contains the implementation of the Language model class within the OpenCart administrative localisation namespace. It provides methods for adding, editing, and deleting language entries, as well as managing related descriptions for various localisation components such as categories, attributes, banners, products, and other entities. The class interacts with the database, cache, and other models to perform multilingual data management tasks.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: The Language class handles CRUD operations for language entries in the localisation module of the OpenCart admin panel. It provides methods to add, update, and delete languages, along with managing related multilingual descriptions for various components such as categories, attributes, banners, and other localisation entities. It interacts with the database, cache, and other models to maintain consistency across the multilingual data.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: The Language class handles CRUD operations for language entries in the localisation module of the OpenCart admin panel. It provides methods to add, update, delete languages, and fetch language data by ID, code, or extension. It also manages retrieving lists of languages with sorting and pagination, including image path handling based on language extension or code.

methods.name: addLanguage
methods.description: Inserts a new language record into the database with the provided data, clears the language cache, and populates related descriptions for attributes, attribute groups, banners, categories, customer groups, custom fields, download descriptions, filter descriptions, order statuses, products, return actions, return reasons, return statuses, stock statuses, voucher themes, weight and length classes, options, subscription plans, subscription statuses, SEO URLs, and other localisation entities. Returns the new language ID.

methods.name: editLanguage
methods.description: Updates an existing language record in the database identified by $language_id with the provided data, then clears the language cache.

methods.name: deleteLanguage
methods.description: Deletes the language record identified by $language_id from the database, clears the cache, and removes all associated descriptions for related localisation components in multiple tables.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves a language record from the database by its ID, enriching the data with appropriate image paths based on the extension or code, for use in the application.

methods.name: getLanguageByCode
methods.description: Fetches a language record matching the specified code, similarly assigning the image URL based on extension or code, facilitating language selection or display.

methods.name: getLanguages
methods.description: Fetches a list of languages with optional sorting, order, start, and limit parameters, supporting pagination and display in admin or frontend.

methods.name: getTotalLanguages
methods.description: Returns the total count of language records in the database, useful for pagination calculations.
